title: Separate silicon from oxygen
caption: The furnace changes chemistry. Carbon-bearing inputs help carry oxygen away in gaseous products; the recovered silicon still needs purification.

nodes.label: Quartz-rich feed
nodes.detail: Silicon is chemically bound to oxygen in silica.

nodes.label: Submerged-arc furnace
nodes.detail: Electrical heating drives reduction with carbon.

nodes.label: Recovered silicon
nodes.detail: Metallurgical silicon remains too contaminated for a chip wafer.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Purify silicon by changing its form
caption: Fluid compounds can be separated by distillation before silicon is deposited again as a solid.

nodes.label: Metallurgical silicon
nodes.detail: The starting solid contains unwanted impurities.

nodes.label: Volatile compound
nodes.detail: Convert silicon to a processable chemical such as trichlorosilane.

nodes.label: Distillation
nodes.detail: Separate fluid species through repeated evaporation and condensation.

nodes.label: Polysilicon
nodes.detail: Deposit purified silicon onto a solid growth surface.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: A seed guides the growing crystal
caption: During CZ growth, the seed contacts the melt and is withdrawn as silicon solidifies in its crystal orientation.

nodes.label: Crucible and melt
nodes.detail: Quartz contains the molten silicon.

nodes.label: Seed contact
nodes.detail: An existing ordered crystal establishes the orientation.

nodes.label: Growing ingot
nodes.detail: Pulling and thermal control maintain controlled solidification.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: One internal-gettering arrangement
caption: In an internal-gettering arrangement, a device-compatible region near the surface is separated from impurity collection sites in the bulk. This is one strategy, not a universal wafer specification; oxygen and heat treatments must suit the device.

nodes.label: Device region
nodes.detail: Contamination here can disturb electrical behavior.

nodes.label: Near-surface crystal
nodes.detail: The intended device region is kept suitable for fabrication.

nodes.label: Bulk collection sites
nodes.detail: Selected sites collect unwanted impurities away from the devices.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: A sliced disc needs several finishing steps
caption: Cutting creates kerf loss and damage. Subsequent processing removes damaged material and brings geometry and surface quality into specification.

nodes.label: Slice
nodes.detail: Divide the ingot; the cutting gap consumes silicon.

nodes.label: Correct geometry
nodes.detail: Remove damage and improve the wafer shape.

nodes.label: Polish
nodes.detail: Produce the required smooth, flat surface.

nodes.label: Clean
nodes.detail: Remove residues left by finishing.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Protect the surface through the last handoff
caption: Cleaning is a sequence of chemical removal, rinsing, drying and inspection. The final surface must survive handling and shipment.

nodes.label: Remove residues
nodes.detail: Select chemistry for the contamination and surface.

nodes.label: Rinse and dry
nodes.detail: Remove dissolved contaminants without leaving new residues.

nodes.label: Inspect
nodes.detail: Check the wafer against acceptance requirements.

nodes.label: Protect
nodes.detail: Maintain cleanliness during storage and delivery.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.
